ARABIC LANGUAGE — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does the Arabic word مَعَ السَّلَامَةِ (maʿa s-salaama) mean? (1 mark)
   A. How are you? (to a boy)
   B. goodbye
   C. my name is
   D. hello

2. Which pair of words are two family members from the father's side and the mother's side? (1 mark)
   A. ab and umm
   B. ibn and bint
   C. akh and ukht
   D. ʿamm and khaal

3. How is the Arabic word صَدِيقٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. dawrii
   B. sadiiq
   C. dawruka
   D. kaʿka

4. What does the Arabic sentence كُلَّ عَامٍ وَأَنْتُمْ بِخَيْرٍ mean? (1 mark)
   A. Happy birthday.
   B. Blessed festival (Happy Eid).
   C. Do you have a party? (to a boy)
   D. May you be well every year.

5. How is the Arabic word دَوْرِي read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. ʿasiir
   B. mabruuk
   C. dawrii
   D. ʿiid

6. What does the Arabic word خُبْزٌ (khubz) mean? (1 mark)
   A. apples
   B. fruit
   C. vegetables
   D. bread

7. What does the Arabic word بُرْتُقَالٌ (burtuqaal) mean? (1 mark)
   A. meat
   B. eggs
   C. oranges
   D. fish

8. What does the Arabic word رَأْسٌ (raʾs) mean? (1 mark)
   A. mouth
   B. body
   C. shoulder
   D. head

9. Which Arabic sentence means "The water is clean." (1 mark)
   A. الْجَوُّ مُمْطِرٌ
   B. الْجَوُّ حَارٌّ
   C. الْجَوُّ بَارِدٌ
   D. الْمَاءُ نَظِيفٌ

10. How do you read the syllable سُ? (1 mark)
   A. laa
   B. bu
   C. su
   D. na

11. What does the Arabic sentence هَدِيَّةٌ لِأَمِينَةَ mean? (1 mark)
   A. Above the table there is a balloon.
   B. On the table there is a cake.
   C. A gift for Amina.
   D. This is a party.

12. How is the Arabic word شَايٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. khubz
   B. shaay
   C. tamaatim
   D. dajaaj

13. Which Arabic word means "bread"? (1 mark)
   A. طَمَاطِمُ
   B. خُبْزٌ
   C. سُكَّرٌ
   D. تُفَّاحٌ

14. Which Arabic word means "oranges"? (1 mark)
   A. بَطَاطِسُ
   B. طَمَاطِمُ
   C. سَمَكٌ
   D. بُرْتُقَالٌ

15. Which Arabic word means "head"? (1 mark)
   A. أُذُنٌ
   B. رَأْسٌ
   C. فَمٌ
   D. سِنٌّ

16. What does the Arabic sentence وَالْمَطَرُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. How beautiful the environment is!
   B. And the rain is from the sky.
   C. The sun is in the sky.
   D. I go to school on Monday.

17. Which Arabic sentence means "Do not play with the knife." (1 mark)
   A. عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ كُوبٌ
   B. لَا تَلْعَبْ بِالسِّكِّينِ
   C. الْمِفْتَاحُ فِي الْخِزَانَةِ
   D. الْكُرْسِيُّ عِنْدَ الْبَابِ

18. What is the name of the Arabic letter ي? (1 mark)
   A. yaa
   B. zaay
   C. waaw
   D. Saad

19. What is the short line ـ used for in Arabic letter tables? (1 mark)
   A. It is a full stop
   B. It shows where a letter joins to another
   C. It is a dot
   D. It is a vowel

20. Which Arabic word means "small"? (1 mark)
   A. خَالَةٌ
   B. قَدَمٌ
   C. صَغِيرٌ
   D. صَبَاحُ الْخَيْرِ

21. Which Arabic sentence means "The chair is new." (1 mark)
   A. الْبَابُ كَبِيرٌ
   B. النَّافِذَةُ نَظِيفَةٌ
   C. الطَّاوِلَةُ صَغِيرَةٌ
   D. الْكُرْسِيُّ جَدِيدٌ

22. What does the Arabic sentence النَّافِذَةُ نَظِيفَةٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The table is small.
   B. The chair is new.
   C. The window is clean.
   D. The door is big.

23. What does ʿindii hadiyya mean? (1 mark)
   A. I like the party.
   B. I have a gift.
   C. I drink juice.
   D. We dance.

24. Which Arabic word means "fruit"? (1 mark)
   A. يَوْمٌ
   B. فَاكِهَةٌ
   C. لَذِيذٌ
   D. إِصْبَعٌ

25. What does the Arabic word طَمَاطِمُ (tamaatim) mean? (1 mark)
   A. water
   B. fruit
   C. salt
   D. tomatoes

26. What is a stanza? (1 mark)
   A. A drawing
   B. A kind of word
   C. A spelling test
   D. A group of lines in a poem

27. Which Arabic word means "face"? (1 mark)
   A. رَأْسٌ
   B. وَجْهٌ
   C. أُذُنٌ
   D. لِسَانٌ

28. What does the Arabic sentence يَدِي صَغِيرَةٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. My head is big.
   B. I wash my face.
   C. My hand is small.
   D. I clean my teeth.

29. What does the Arabic word مَطَرٌ (matar) mean? (1 mark)
   A. sunny
   B. weather
   C. rain
   D. wind

30. What does the Arabic word تَحْتَ (taHta) mean? (1 mark)
   A. on
   B. under
   C. behind
   D. beside

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Explain the difference between a direct question and an inferential question. Give one example of each about a text on breakfast. (4 marks) (4 marks)

32. Give three ways in which a family can reduce food wastage at home. (3 marks) (3 marks)

33. Translate into English: ashrabu l-haliiba (2 marks)

34. Translate into English: jaddatii tuhibbunii (2 marks)

35. Describe the steps for learning to write a new letter. (4 marks) (4 marks)

36. Translate into English: haadhaa baytii (2 marks)

37. Translate into English: al-qittatu taHta s-sariir (2 marks)

38. Write two describing words in Arabic sounds with their meanings, one for a masculine and one for a feminine item. (3 marks) (3 marks)

39. Translate into English: anaa ʿinda l-baab (2 marks)

40. Explain what it means to read with fluency and give two tips for reading fluently. (3 marks) (3 marks)

41. Write five parts of the body in Arabic (English letters are fine) with their meanings. (5 marks) (5 marks)

42. Rearrange the words and translate: الْعَصِيرَ / أَشْرَبُ. (2 marks) (2 marks)

43. Give three tips for neat handwriting with good word spacing. (3 marks) (3 marks)

44. Name the four marks (harakat) that show short vowels or no vowel and say what each one shows. (4 marks) (4 marks)

45. Put the words in order and translate: كَبِيرٌ / بَيْتِي. (2 marks) (2 marks)

46. Translate into English: yadii Sagiira (2 marks)

47. Translate into English: ash-shamsu fii s-samaa'i (2 marks)

48. Say where the pen is if it is in the bag. Write the sentence in English letters and translate it. (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — MOCK EXAM #10 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — goodbye
   مَعَ السَّلَامَةِ (maʿa s-salaama) means goodbye.

2. D — ʿamm and khaal
   ʿamm is the father's brother and khaal is the mother's brother.

3. B — sadiiq
   صَدِيقٌ is read sadiiq and means friend.

4. D — May you be well every year.
   كُلَّ عَامٍ وَأَنْتُمْ بِخَيْرٍ (kulla ʿaamin wa-antum bi-khayr) means: May you be well every year.

5. C — dawrii
   دَوْرِي is read dawrii and means my turn.

6. D — bread
   خُبْزٌ (khubz) means bread.

7. C — oranges
   بُرْتُقَالٌ (burtuqaal) means oranges.

8. D — head
   رَأْسٌ (raʾs) means head.

9. D — الْمَاءُ نَظِيفٌ
   الْمَاءُ نَظِيفٌ (al-maa'u nadhiif) means: The water is clean.

10. C — su
   سُ is read su.

11. C — A gift for Amina.
   هَدِيَّةٌ لِأَمِينَةَ (hadiyya li-Aminata) means: A gift for Amina.

12. B — shaay
   شَايٌ is read shaay and means tea.

13. B — خُبْزٌ
   خُبْزٌ (khubz) means bread.

14. D — بُرْتُقَالٌ
   بُرْتُقَالٌ (burtuqaal) means oranges.

15. B — رَأْسٌ
   رَأْسٌ (raʾs) means head.

16. B — And the rain is from the sky.
   وَالْمَطَرُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ (wal-maTaru mina s-samaa'i) means: And the rain is from the sky.

17. B — لَا تَلْعَبْ بِالسِّكِّينِ
   لَا تَلْعَبْ بِالسِّكِّينِ (laa talʿab bi-s-sikkiin) means: Do not play with the knife.

18. A — yaa
   The letter ي is called yaa.

19. B — It shows where a letter joins to another
   The line is called a tatweel and shows joining.

20. C — صَغِيرٌ
   صَغِيرٌ (Sagiir) means small.

21. D — الْكُرْسِيُّ جَدِيدٌ
   الْكُرْسِيُّ جَدِيدٌ (al-kursiyyu jadiid) means: The chair is new.

22. C — The window is clean.
   النَّافِذَةُ نَظِيفَةٌ (an-naafidhatu nadhiifa) means: The window is clean.

23. B — I have a gift.
   ʿindii means I have and hadiyya means gift.

24. B — فَاكِهَةٌ
   فَاكِهَةٌ (faakiha) means fruit.

25. D — tomatoes
   طَمَاطِمُ (tamaatim) means tomatoes.

26. D — A group of lines in a poem
   A stanza is like a paragraph in a poem.

27. B — وَجْهٌ
   وَجْهٌ (wajh) means face.

28. C — My hand is small.
   يَدِي صَغِيرَةٌ (yadii Sagiira) means: My hand is small.

29. C — rain
   مَطَرٌ (matar) means rain.

30. B — under
   تَحْتَ (taHta) means under.

SECTION B
----
31. (4 marks)
   Answer: A direct question has its answer in the text, for example 'What does she drink?' An inferential question needs clues, for example 'Is it morning?'.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each definition and 1 mark for each suitable example.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: Cook only what is needed; store leftovers and eat them later; share extra food; use peels for compost.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sensible way.

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: I drink milk.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: My grandmother loves me.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

35. (4 marks)
   Answer: Trace the model; copy it several times from right to left; write it from memory and compare; add and check the dots.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

36. (2 marks)
   Answer: This is my house.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

37. (2 marks)
   Answer: The cat is under the bed.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: kabiir (big) for a masculine word and kabiira (big) for a feminine word.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each form and 1 mark for the meaning.

39. (2 marks)
   Answer: I am at the door.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: Fluency means reading smoothly at a steady speed with correct words. Tips: put a finger under each word; practise at slow and normal speed.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning and 1 mark for each tip.

41. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example raʾs (head), wajh (face), shaʿr (hair), ʿayn (eye), udhun (ear).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its meaning.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: أَشْرَبُ الْعَصِيرَ. I drink juice.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the order and 1 mark for the translation.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Leave a gap about one letter wide between words; keep letters in a word joined smoothly; write on the baseline; put dots neatly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid tip.

44. (4 marks)
   Answer: fatHa gives a, kasra gives i, Damma gives u, and sukuun shows no vowel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each mark and its meaning.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: بَيْتِي كَبِيرٌ. My house is big.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the order and 1 mark for the translation.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: My hand is small.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: The sun is in the sky.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

48. (3 marks)
   Answer: al-qalamu fii l-haqiiba. The pen is in the bag.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the item, 1 mark for the position word fii, 1 mark for the translation.
